description: The founder's moderation: ends one person's follow of another — or cancels their follow request still waiting — at once (New links stop at once; a link already opened stops working within 5 minutes.): whatever that follow opened to them (followers-only posts and files, a private account's posts and lists) closes with it. Nobody is told; they can follow again. In Development it is done at once. In Live (env live) it asks the founder to approve it in their browser, and approving it carries it out, once. people_graph lists who follows whom. On the founder's Logs, on the follower's page.

followee.description: the person they follow (usr_…); in Live an email works too

follower.description: the follower's id (usr_…); in Live an email works too

note.description: Live only: one line for your human, why
